name: Anata wa Akumade Watashi no Mono
original_name: 貴方はあくまで私のもの
source:
The protagonist, Akito Asagumo, had come on a summer trip with his close classmates to make some memories.
At a friend’s vacation home on a deserted island, Akito finds himself caught up in a terrifying murder case……
translation:
主人公浅云明人为了留下一些回忆，和好同学一起来暑假旅行。
在荒岛上朋友的度假屋里，明人发现自己卷入了一场可怕的谋杀案……
